title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
summary: 從 European XFEL 的 3.4 km 超導直線加速器與每秒 10 列、每列最多 2700 發的突發模式出發，理解射頻脈衝預算、波盪器共振與段間相位、2 K 低溫負載、掠射反射鏡面形、AGIPD 記憶格校正、束團分配與機器保護如何串成一座可交接的硬 X 光雷射設施。
summaryEn: Starting from the 3.4 km superconducting linac of European XFEL and its burst mode of 10 trains per second with up to 2700 pulses each, see how the RF pulse budget, undulator resonance and inter-segment phase, 2 K cryogenic load, grazing-mirror figure, AGIPD memory-cell calibration, bunch distribution and machine protection combine into a hard X-ray laser facility that can be handed over.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 操作點練習：使用者要求 SASE1 在 9.0 keV，電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397），λu = 40 mm。λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm；1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17，所以 K ≈ 2.89，對應峰值磁場 B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T。段間 1.1 m 漂移的落後量為 1.1/(0.040×5.17) ≈ 5.32λ，移相器需補約 0.68λ ≈ 0.094 nm。若電子能量抖動 0.05%，光子能量抖動約 0.1%，即 9 eV。AGIPD 若以每 4 個束團取 1 發（約 889 ns、1.125 MHz）記錄，352 個記憶格涵蓋 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs，大約是 600 µs 脈衝列的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表設施的實際設定。
workedExample.textEn: Operating-point exercise: a user asks for 9.0 keV from SASE1 at 14 GeV (γ ≈ 27,397) with λu = 40 mm. λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm; 1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17, so K ≈ 2.89, a peak field B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T. The 1.1 m intersection drift slips 1.1/(0.040×5.17) ≈ 5.32λ, so the phase shifter adds about 0.68λ ≈ 0.094 nm. An electron-energy jitter of 0.05% becomes about 0.1% photon-energy jitter, 9 eV. If AGIPD records every fourth bunch (about 889 ns, 1.125 MHz), its 352 memory cells span 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs, roughly half of the 600 µs train. Values are teaching assumptions, not the facility's actual settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」與「波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget" and "Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: European XFEL 全長 3.4 km，從漢堡 DESY 延伸到 Schenefeld；其中 2.1 km 的加速器以 1.3 GHz TESLA 型鈮超導腔在約 2 K 運轉。超導腔壁的表面電阻極低，射頻能量幾乎不在腔壁耗散，因此可以使用約 1.5 ms 的長射頻脈衝，每秒 10 列，每列以 4.5 MHz（間隔約 222 ns）放入最多 2700 個電子束團，合計每秒最多 27,000 發 X 光脈衝。列與列之間約 99.4 ms 的空檔留給低溫系統、偵測器讀出與機器保護恢復。這種突發模式與每秒百餘發的常溫銅腔或連續波機器是完全不同的系統邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: European XFEL is 3.4 km long, running from DESY in Hamburg to Schenefeld; its 2.1 km accelerator uses 1.3 GHz TESLA-type niobium superconducting cavities at about 2 K. Because the superconducting wall resistance is tiny, almost no RF energy is dissipated in the walls, so RF pulses of about 1.5 ms are possible: 10 trains per second, each holding up to 2700 electron bunches at 4.5 MHz (about 222 ns apart), for up to 27,000 X-ray pulses per second. The roughly 99.4 ms gap between trains lets the cryogenics, detector readout and machine protection recover. This burst mode is a completely different system boundary from a copper linac firing about a hundred pulses per second or a continuous-wave machine. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腔體場的時間常數 τ = Q_L/(π·f₀)；假設負載 Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶、f₀ = 1.3 GHz，τ ≈ 1.13 ms，以先強後穩的充填策略約需 τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms 到達平頂。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The cavity field time constant is τ = Q_L/(π·f₀); assuming a loaded Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶ and f₀ = 1.3 GHz, τ ≈ 1.13 ms, and a boosted fill reaches flat top after about τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腔體場的時間常數 τ = Q_L/(π·f₀)；假設負載 Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶、f₀ = 1.3 GHz，τ ≈ 1.13 ms，以先強後穩的充填策略約需 τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms 到達平頂。2700 個束團 × 222 ns ≈ 0.60 ms 的平頂加上充填共約 1.38 ms，落在約 1.5 ms 的速調管脈衝之內；每秒脈衝數為 10 × 2700 = 27,000。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The cavity field time constant is τ = Q_L/(π·f₀); assuming a loaded Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶ and f₀ = 1.3 GHz, τ ≈ 1.13 ms, and a boosted fill reaches flat top after about τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms. A flat top of 2700 bunches × 222 ns ≈ 0.60 ms plus the fill totals about 1.38 ms, inside the roughly 1.5 ms klystron pulse; pulses per second are 10 × 2700 = 27,000. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致；再以束流電荷監測器與束流位置監測器逐束團記錄電荷與軌跡，確認 2700 個位置都落在平頂內，且平頂幅度與相位的漂移在規格內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above; then log charge and orbit bunch by bunch with charge monitors and beam-position monitors to confirm that all 2700 slots sit on the flat top and that amplitude and phase drift along the flat top stay within specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致；再以束流電荷監測器與束流位置監測器逐束團記錄電荷與軌跡，確認 2700 個位置都落在平頂內，且平頂幅度與相位的漂移在規格內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above; then log charge and orbit bunch by bunch with charge monitors and beam-position monitors to confirm that all 2700 slots sit on the flat top and that amplitude and phase drift along the flat top stay within specification. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks; bunches at the end of the train are accelerated on a falling field and arrive low in energy, their undulator resonance shifts and the tail of the train loses lasing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致；再以束流電荷監測器與束流位置監測器逐束團記錄電荷與軌跡，確認 2700 個位置都落在平頂內，且平頂幅度與相位的漂移在規格內。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget"?
options: 用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。
optionsEn: Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent.
quiz.explanation: 用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致；再以束流電荷監測器與束流位置監測器逐束團記錄電荷與軌跡，確認 2700 個位置都落在平頂內，且平頂幅度與相位的漂移在規格內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above; then log charge and orbit bunch by bunch with charge monitors and beam-position monitors to confirm that all 2700 slots sit on the flat top and that amplitude and phase drift along the flat top stay within specification. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks; bunches at the end of the train are accelerated on a falling field and arrive low in energy, their undulator resonance shifts and the tail of the train loses lasing. Users see X-rays only at the start of the train, which is often misdiagnosed as an undulator or optics problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種突發模式與每秒百餘發的常溫銅腔或連續波機器是完全不同的系統邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This burst mode is a completely different system boundary from a copper linac firing about a hundred pulses per second or a continuous-wave machine.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「可變間隙波盪器共振」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Variable-gap undulator resonance” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電子在週期 λu 的交替磁場中蛇行，在電子座標中看到被勞侖茲收縮的磁場週期，發出的輻射再經都卜勒壓縮回實驗室，因此共振波長為 λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2)，K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]。European XFEL 的 SASE1 與 SASE2 為 175 m 長的可變間隙波盪器，涵蓋約 3 keV 到 25 keV 以上；SASE3 長 105 m，涵蓋 0.26 到 3 keV。改變磁鐵間隙就改變 B 與 K，因此電子能量固定時各波盪器仍可獨立調整光子能量，這是多條光束線同時服務使用者的物理基礎。SASE 從電子的散粒雜訊起振，單程通過中指數放大並在飽和前形成微束團。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可變間隙波盪器共振」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Electrons wiggle through an alternating field of period λu; in their own frame they see a Lorentz-contracted period, and the emitted radiation is Doppler-compressed back into the laboratory, giving the resonant wavelength λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2) with K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]. At European XFEL, SASE1 and SASE2 are 175 m variable-gap undulators covering about 3 keV to beyond 25 keV, and SASE3 is 105 m long covering 0.26 to 3 keV. Opening or closing the magnet gap changes B and K, so each undulator tunes its photon energy independently at a fixed electron energy, which is the physical basis for serving several beamlines at once. SASE starts from electron shot noise, amplifies exponentially in a single pass and microbunches the beam before saturation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Variable-gap undulator resonance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「可變間隙波盪器共振」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Variable-gap undulator resonance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可變間隙波盪器共振」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Variable-gap undulator resonance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397）、SASE1 週期 λu = 40 mm、K = 2.5 為例：λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm，約 11.3 keV；把間隙開大到 K = 1.65 時 λ ≈ 0.063 nm，約 19.7 keV。SASE3 週期 68 mm、K = 4.0 時 λ ≈ 0.41 nm，約 3.0 keV。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV. SASE3 with a 68 mm period and K = 4.0 gives λ ≈ 0.41 nm, about 3.0 keV. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「可變間隙波盪器共振」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Variable-gap undulator resonance” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：電子能量讀數若有 0.1% 誤差，因 λ ∝ 1/γ²，光子能量會偏約 0.2%，在 12 keV 約 24 eV，足以讓吸收邊附近的光譜實驗落在錯誤位置；若間隙編碼器零點漂移，則不同光束線之間的能量校正也會互相不一致。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 0.1% error in the electron-energy reading shifts the photon energy by about 0.2% because λ ∝ 1/γ², about 24 eV at 12 keV, enough to put an absorption-edge spectroscopy experiment in the wrong place; a drifting gap-encoder zero also makes the energy calibration of different beamlines disagree.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主加速器有 96 個低溫模組（注入器另有 2 個，其中一個是 3.9 GHz 三次諧波模組，用來線性化縱向相空間），每個模組裝 8 個 1.3 GHz 九格鈮腔。腔體以高純度鈮板深抽成型、電子束焊接，再經電解拋光、高壓超純水沖洗與無塵室組裝，任何殘留微粒都可能成為場發射源。腔體浸在約 2 K 的超流氦中，Q₀ 可達 10¹⁰，但每瓦在 2 K 移除的熱，在室溫端要付出數百瓦以上的壓縮機功率，因此 Q₀ 與工作比直接決定營運成本。腔體由 E. Zanon 與 Research Instruments 兩家廠商各製作一半，模組在 CEA Saclay 組裝後於 DESY 進行射頻測試。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main linac has 96 cryomodules (the injector has 2 more, one a 3.9 GHz third-harmonic module that linearises the longitudinal phase space), each holding eight 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavities. Cavities are deep-drawn from high-purity niobium sheet, electron-beam welded, electropolished, rinsed with high-pressure ultrapure water and assembled in a clean room; any residual particle can become a field-emission site. Immersed in superfluid helium near 2 K they reach Q₀ of 10¹⁰, yet every watt removed at 2 K costs hundreds of watts or more of compressor power at room temperature, so Q₀ and duty factor set operating cost directly. Production was split between E. Zanon and Research Instruments, and modules were assembled at CEA Saclay before RF testing at DESY. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導腔沒有電阻，所以低溫系統只需補償外界熱漏。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。動態熱負載 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)：V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV，R/Q = 1036 Ω，Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰，脈衝內約 58 W；乘上 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% 工作比，每腔平均約 0.87 W，768 腔約 670 W（2 K），尚未計入靜態熱漏。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV. Dynamic load P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀): V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV, R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ give about 58 W during the pulse; with a 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% duty factor that is about 0.87 W per cavity and about 670 W at 2 K for 768 cavities, before static losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Dynamic load P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀): V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV, R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ give about 58 W during the pulse; with a 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% duty factor that is about 0.87 W per cavity and about 670 W at 2 K for 768 cavities, before static losses.

steps.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.

steps.objective: 說明「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。每段的間隙由馬達與編碼器控制，微米級的間隙差就會改變 K；磁量測後以墊片修正電子軌跡與相位誤差。電子在無磁場的間隔中相對於光的落後量與在波盪器中不同，若不補償，各段的輻射以錯誤相位疊加，增益長度變長甚至無法飽和。相位移相器是一個小型磁鐵彎道，加長電子路徑使總落後量為波長的整數倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. Each gap is driven by motors with encoders, and a micrometre gap difference already changes K; after magnetic measurement, shims correct the electron trajectory and phase errors. In the field-free intersection the electron falls behind the light by a different amount than inside the undulator, so without compensation the segments radiate with the wrong relative phase, the gain length grows and saturation may never be reached. The phase shifter is a small magnetic chicane that lengthens the electron path so the total slippage is an integer number of wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「5 m 波盪器段與移相器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “5 m undulator segments and phase shifters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。取 L_d = 1.1 m、γ = 27,397（14 GeV）：ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm；若 λ = 0.110 nm（K = 2.5），相當於 6.67 個波長，移相器需再補約 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm，使總落後為 7λ。光子能量改變時補償量也改變，因此移相器設定必須與 K 值連動查表。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²). With L_d = 1.1 m and γ = 27,397 (14 GeV), ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm; for λ = 0.110 nm (K = 2.5) that is 6.67 wavelengths, so the phase shifter adds about 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm to make the total slip 7λ. The required delay changes with photon energy, so the shifter setting must be tabulated together with K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap; on the machine, measure the gain curve of X-ray pulse energy versus number of closed segments and scan the phase shifter at each intersection, confirming that the pulse-energy maximum lands on the tabulated setting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objective: 說明「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。光束在鏡面上的足跡被拉長為 w/θ，因此鏡長要以公尺計；高度誤差 h 在反射時造成 2h·sinθ 的光程差，對 0.1 nm 的波長，奈米級的高度誤差就足以破壞聚焦與同調波前。突發模式在 0.6 ms 內送來數千發脈衝，鏡面局部吸熱形成熱凸起，需要以冷卻設計與幾何最佳化控制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians. The footprint on the mirror stretches to w/θ, which is why the mirrors are metre-scale, and a height error h produces a path difference 2h·sinθ on reflection; at a 0.1 nm wavelength, nanometre height errors already spoil focusing and the coherent wavefront. Burst mode delivers thousands of pulses within 0.6 ms, so local absorption raises a thermal bump that must be managed by cooling design and geometry. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For B₄C (2.52 g/cm³, 26 electrons per formula unit) at 12 keV (λ ≈ 0.103 nm), δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶ and θc ≈ 2.6 mrad, falling to about 1.3 mrad at 24 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。取 θ = 2.0 mrad，Maréchal 判準 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 給出 h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm；光束寬 0.8 mm（假設）時足跡為 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

At θ = 2.0 mrad the Maréchal condition 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 gives h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm, and an assumed 0.8 mm beam leaves a 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm footprint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：出廠與安裝前以長行程輪廓儀或拼接干涉儀量測鏡面高度與斜率誤差，以功率譜密度分頻段估算對焦斑與同調性的影響；上線後以光柵剪切干涉或刀口掃描量聚焦光斑，並在不同列長下重複，觀察焦點是否隨列內累積熱負載漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipment and installation measure height and slope errors with a long-trace profiler or stitching interferometer and use the power spectral density, band by band, to estimate the effect on focal spot and coherence; on the beamline, measure the focus with grating-based shearing interferometry or knife-edge scans and repeat at several train lengths to see whether the focus drifts with the heat load accumulated during a train.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “AGIPD megapixel detector” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一般積分型偵測器每秒只讀數十到數百張影像，跟不上 4.5 MHz 的脈衝。AGIPD 在每個 200 µm 畫素下方的讀出晶片內放了 352 個類比記憶格，在脈衝列中以最高 4.5 MHz 逐張存下電荷，再利用列間約 99.4 ms 的空檔讀出並數位化。為了在同一張影像內同時記錄單光子與 12.4 keV 下超過一萬個光子的布拉格峰，每個畫素有高、中、低三段自動增益切換；500 µm 厚的矽感測層決定硬 X 光的吸收效率。代價是每個畫素、每個記憶格、每段增益都有自己的偏移與增益係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「AGIPD 百萬畫素偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ordinary integrating detectors read tens to hundreds of frames per second and cannot follow 4.5 MHz pulses. The price is that every pixel, memory cell and gain stage has its own offset and gain coefficient. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 1 Mpixel (1024×1024) system stores at most 352 frames per train, so the data rate is ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 10 Hz × 2 byte ≈ 7.4 GB/s.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1 Mpixel（1024×1024）系統每列最多存 352 張，資料率 ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 10 Hz × 2 byte ≈ 7.4 GB/s。校正常數 ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 3 段增益 × 2（偏移與增益）≈ 2.2×10⁹ 個。每列 2700 發只能記 352 張，最高利用率 352/2700 ≈ 13%，所以常以較低的列內重複率選發。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。三台波盪器因此共用電子能量，但以各自的間隙設定光子能量；分配切換需要一段時間空檔，各光束線的束團數會互相牽動。實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The three undulators therefore share one electron energy but set their photon energies with their own gaps; switching needs a time gap, so the bunch counts of the beamlines are coupled. Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast kickers and bunch pattern”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。若 SASE2 分得 1000 發，SASE1/3 剩 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610 發。14 GeV 時 SASE1 在 K = 2.5 給 11.3 keV，同一批電子進 SASE3 若要 1.0 keV，需 K ≈ 7.3（λu = 68 mm）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700. If SASE2 receives 1000 bunches, SASE1/3 keep 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610. At 14 GeV, SASE1 at K = 2.5 gives 11.3 keV, and for the same electrons to give 1.0 keV in SASE3 needs K ≈ 7.3 (λu = 68 mm). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis. steps.observation: 注意干擾：平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking"?
options: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。
optionsEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.
quiz.explanation: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速踢磁鐵與束團模式」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fast kickers and bunch pattern” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏。
超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index.
A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流損失監測與捕集器」如何決定European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” determines the key performance of “European XFEL”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 17.5 GeV、每秒 27,000 個束團下，電子束平均功率可達百 kW 級以上，一整列打到真空管或波盪器磁鐵都可能造成損傷，或讓 NdFeB 永久磁鐵受輻射去磁。機器保護系統以束流損失監測器、軌跡與入出口電荷差在脈衝列內即時判斷，在微秒級時間內停止後續束團；波盪器旁的劑量計長期追蹤累積輻射。X 光側也要限制每列的總能量，避免反射鏡與樣品前光學元件被熱負載或燒蝕破壞。交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流損失監測與捕集器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. Machine protection judges beam-loss monitors, orbit and the charge difference between entrance and exit within the train and stops the following bunches within microseconds, while dosimeters beside the undulators track accumulated radiation. On the X-ray side the energy per train must also be limited so that mirrors and optics in front of the sample are not destroyed by heat or ablation. The handoff records energy, charge, train length, undulator settings, detector mode and protection thresholds together. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-loss monitors and dumps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流損失監測與捕集器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流損失監測與捕集器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。X 光每發 2 mJ 在 12.4 keV 約 1.0×10¹² 光子，2700 發在 0.6 ms 內傳送 5.4 J，列內瞬時功率約 9 kW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ. At 2 mJ per X-ray pulse, 12.4 keV gives about 1.0×10¹² photons, and 2700 pulses deliver 5.4 J in 0.6 ms, about 9 kW during the train. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流損失監測與捕集器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若保護系統只在列與列之間判斷而無法在列內中止，一次軌跡錯誤會讓整列約 12 kJ 的電子能量集中在同一點，熔穿真空管或讓一段波盪器去磁，造成數週停機與重新磁量測。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If protection only acts between trains and cannot stop a train in progress, a single orbit error dumps about 12 kJ of electron energy into one spot, which can puncture the vacuum pipe or demagnetise an undulator segment and cause weeks of downtime and remeasurement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。
knowledge.textEn: During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束流損失監測與捕集器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-loss monitors and dumps” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若保護系統只在列與列之間判斷而無法在列內中止，一次軌跡錯誤會讓整列約 12 kJ 的電子能量集中在同一點，熔穿真空管或讓一段波盪器去磁，造成數週停機與重新磁量測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If protection only acts between trains and cannot stop a train in progress, a single orbit error dumps about 12 kJ of electron energy into one spot, which can puncture the vacuum pipe or demagnetise an undulator segment and cause weeks of downtime and remeasurement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff records energy, charge, train length, undulator settings, detector mode and protection thresholds together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
